name: binwalk
notes: Homebrew's Apple Silicon bottle (formula binwalk 3.1.0); bin/binwalk links to /opt/homebrew/bin/binwalk. The earlier cargo build is kept aside in bin.local-build/. test.sh builds a hand-made blob with gzip at 0x400, xz at 0x800 and a standalone zlib file, runs binwalk -e, and checks the signatures and extracted payloads. Passed on 2026-10-16 with the Homebrew build.
